partitions.name: manifest
partitions.purpose: schema, input, code, partition, and logical-content hashes

partitions.name: identity_dictionary
partitions.purpose: stable exact contract-id UTF-8 dictionary and redundant identity fields

partitions.name: market_context
partitions.purpose: one copy of each causal synchronized market-context minute

partitions.name: contract_paths
partitions.purpose: one copy of each exact contract-minute causal path

partitions.name: flat_decisions
partitions.purpose: 09:32 through 15:30 flat decision identities and current ladder maps

partitions.name: open_state_scaffolds
partitions.purpose: 15:30 through 15:54 learned manage/exit source rows plus the non-model 15:55 FORCED_FLAT_TERMINAL event, with a dedicated identity-keyed open-contract record independent of the recentered flat-entry ladder

partitions.name: open_contract_paths
partitions.purpose: dedicated exact open-position history and current quotes, retained even when the contract leaves the recentered 42-slot ladder

partitions.name: entry_intent_and_fill_recheck_events
partitions.purpose: immutable decision-t intent masks, selected identity, selected-contract-only t+1 recheck, pass/rejection reason, zero-charge rejected-fill accounting, and ledger-event hash

partitions.name: labels
partitions.purpose: physically separate FT2-04 family targets keyed to contract-minutes

partitions.name: checkpoints
partitions.purpose: atomic resume state and completion markers

deduplication.window_materialization: never persist repeated 90 by 42 decision windows
deduplication.batch_assembly: join the current ladder identity map to shared contract paths and slice the trailing 90 same-session minutes
deduplication.expected_benefit_is_planning_only: authority estimates 10x to 20x path reuse; FT2-30 must measure actuals

atomic_commit.commit: atomic rename after every required check passes

skip_completed_partition_only_if_all_mat: label spec hash when labels are built
resume.mismatch_action: discard only the mismatched temporary/derived partition and rebuild it

precision.option_price: int32 cents plus uint8 tick regime

hashing.manifest: single packet and per-store manifest with sorted relative paths
hashing.json_canonicalization: UTF-8, sorted object keys, separators comma/colon, no NaN or Infinity
hashing.logical_table_hash: fixed schema and column order; rows in frozen key order; little-endian fixed-width values plus validity bitmaps
hashing.reason: logical reproducibility must not depend on compression or writer metadata
